hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if command -v odoo-nix >/dev/null 2>&1; then odoo-nix agent hook session-start; elif command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1; then nix develop --no-pure-eval .#odoo-nix-lint -c odoo-nix agent hook session-start; fi

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if command -v odoo-nix >/dev/null 2>&1; then odoo-nix agent hook pre-bash; elif command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1; then nix develop --no-pure-eval .#odoo-nix-lint -c odoo-nix agent hook pre-bash; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running the lint gate before a push...

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if command -v odoo-nix >/dev/null 2>&1; then odoo-nix agent hook stop; elif command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1; then nix develop --no-pure-eval .#odoo-nix-lint -c odoo-nix agent hook stop; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running the pre-commit hooks on the changed files...
